test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Launched in May 2020, which of the following scheme unifies all efforts related to digital / online / on-air education to enable coherent multi-mode access to education?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM e-Vidya**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** PM e-Vidya scheme was launched on May 17, 2020 **to provide access to education through digital, online, and on-air platforms.
 
• The scheme **was part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan.** 
 
• The **scheme aims to reduce learning losses, especially during the COVID-19 pande**mic. 
 
• It** unifies all efforts related to digital, online, and on-air education. **
 
• **It provides multi-mode access to education**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scheme include**

 
 
• **DIKSHA: **A digital platform for education that stores e-content
 
• **Swayam Prabha TV**: A TV channel for each class from 1 to 12
 
• **Radio and community radio**: Curriculum-based radio programs for classes 1 to 12
 
• **Mobile podcasts: **Curriculum-based podcasts for classes 1 to 12
 
• **Special e-content: **Content for children with special needs, such as Indian Sign Language (ISL) videos and talking books
